title.suggested: LaBlanche visited Allen before the Daly contest

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that George LaBlanche, the Marine, visited Tom Allen and Tom Kelly on arriving in St. Louis, then signed to box Dan Daly six rounds at Union Park on Oct. 14.

metadata.notes: No masthead visible in either image.

notes: Headline reads 'THE DALY-LA BLANCHE CONTEST' (singular). The current summary says Allen and Kelly brokered the agreement; the article says only that LaBlanche visited them. Allen's role is a single mention, so no facts were recorded.
